subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Atuar de forma fundamentada, ética e crítica na produção e no compartilhamento de comentários, textos noticiosos e de opinião, memes, gifs, remixes variados etc. em redes sociais ou outros ambientes digitais.

components.description_pt: Identificar responsabilidades éticas envolvidas na produção e compartilhamento de conteúdo em redes sociais e ambientes digitais
components.description_en: Identify ethical responsibilities involved in producing and sharing content on social networks and digital environments
components.cc_component_description: Identify personal rights and responsibilities presented in informational sources

components.description_pt: Analisar os possíveis impactos de compartilhar comentários, memes, remixes e textos noticiosos em espaços digitais
components.description_en: Analyze the potential impacts of sharing comments, memes, remixes, and news texts in digital spaces

components.description_pt: Produzir conteúdo digital como comentários e textos opinativos de forma crítica, informada e eticamente responsável
components.description_en: Produce digital content such as comments and opinion texts in a critical, informed, and ethically responsible manner
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and publish a piece of writing

components.description_pt: Avaliar a credibilidade e implicações éticas de conteúdo antes de compartilhá-lo em ambientes digitais
components.description_en: Evaluate the credibility and ethical implications of content before sharing it in digital environments
components.cc_component_description: Assess the credibility and accuracy of print and digital sources

cc_matches.description:
Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar información para...
* reflexionar sobre temas relacionados a preguntas de apoyo
* visualizar detalles relevantes
* definir atributos y características de artefactos
* identificar sus derechos y responsabilidades
* responder a preguntas apropiadas para la exploración
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and present the relationships between information and ideas efficiently as well as to interact and collaborate with others.

Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources, using search terms effectively; assess the credibility and accuracy of each source; and quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and following a standard format for citation.
